title: Implement Task schemas, lifecycle, and check/measurement/follow-up services
verify: Task schemas and status lifecycle exist for check_task, measurement_task, follow_up_task, and action_task placeholders.
check_task and measurement_task creation requires ActorContext and PlantAccessGrant but not physical-action approval.
Consultant cannot create domain task/recommendation/action records by default.
Archived Plant, revoked grant, disabled membership, and unauthorized scope fail closed.
evidence_required: task schema and lifecycle unit tests
authorization and PlantAccessGrant denial integration tests
negative test proving check/measurement tasks do not unlock action_task
constraints: Task records are actor/Farm/Plant scoped and PostgreSQL/read model authority.
check_task and measurement_task are data-gathering tasks and do not require physical-action approval.
Task creation/mutation never triggers automated device execution.
invariants: Every task mutation resolves ActorContext and PlantAccessGrant before mutation.
action_task remains locked until Safety Gate clearance and authorized human approval.
Failed task creation must not publish successful Bus/UI/timeline refs.
verification_targets: check and measurement tasks without physical-action approval
